name: Lofexidine
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: CYP2D6 is the main hepatic enzyme identified in vitro; CYP1A2/CYP2C19 also contribute. First-pass metabolism forms inactive products; parent and metabolites are eliminated mainly renally.
